content.comment_body: I'm looking for the [product_name] USB cable driver for Windows 10. Could someone let me know where to find it?
You can download it from here: CP210x Universal Windows Driver V11.0.0
Great, this actually works! I spent all day searching forums and websites to connect to one of my older [product_name] devices. Thanks!
[user_name]: Please tell me how to use this link, because after downloading and extracting, there aren't any executable files.
Hello [user_name], welcome to the forum. This is an English-speaking forum—please post in English next time. Thank you.
After extracting, check the file CP210x_Universal_Windows_Driver_ReleaseNotes.txt in the section titled "Manual install."

analysis.insight_summary: Users have trouble finding and installing the appropriate USB cable driver for [product_name] modules under Windows 10. The driver is not easy to locate, causing users to rely on community recommendations and spend significant time searching. Additionally, installation is unclear for some users, due to absence of executable files and limited instructions after downloading.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect the process of finding and installing a compatible USB cable driver for [product_name] modules on Windows 10 to be straightforward, with an easy-to-find executable installer and clear installation instructions.
